coherent_sampling: GLIMPSE_sample sample mode draws one iteration index per individual and uses it at every site; never select independently per SNP
ligation: GLIMPSE_ligate aligns/switches corresponding HS iteration pairs across chunk overlaps
GT_source_history: GLIMPSE_phase writer emits unphased GT; GLIMPSE_sample writes phased GT and clears HS/GP/DS. Actual merged public prefix retains phasedGT+HS/GP; its later processing cannot be reconstructed from header alone.
source_header_variation: public header says max16pairs, frozen phase v1 source text says max15; actualNMAIN15 and 30bit range control this dataset. No claim that downloaded tag bytes equal original executable build.
phase_qualified_scope: first32 complete records only; actual region/phase provenance still a root gate
posterior_draws: may change both genotype and phase; not a true-phasing-error or ancestry-accuracy benchmark
